First, note the date format: 07-23-1004 is MM-DD-YYYY → 1004-07-23.  
40 weeks + 2 days = 40 × 7 + 2 = 282 days.  

1004 is a leap year (divisible by 4) but not by 100, so Feb has 29 days.  
From 1004-07-23:  
Days left in July: 31 - 23 = 8 → 282 - 8 = 274 left.  
August: 31 → 274 - 31 = 243 left.  
September: 30 → 243 - 30 = 213 left.  
October: 31 → 213 - 31 = 182 left.  
November: 30 → 182 - 30 = 152 left.  
December: 31 → 152 - 31 = 121 left.  
Remaining into 1005 (not leap year, 1005 not divisible by 4).  

January 1005: 31 → 121 - 31 = 90 left.  
February: 28 → 90 - 28 = 62 left.  
March: 31 → 62 - 31 = 31 left.  
April: 30 → 31 - 30 = 1 left.  
May: 1 day → date is 1005-05-01.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-05-01
